title: Develop partnerships and ecosystems
summary: Bring relevant organisations and communities together around a specific, shared challenge.
detail: The intended role is to help clarify the need, participating roles, decision rights, safeguards and delivery path. No organisation is represented as a partner until the relationship is approved and documented.
problem: Useful initiatives can stall when people, resources, responsibilities and evidence requirements remain disconnected.
exclusions: A partnership created by submitting an enquiry
Unapproved affiliation, endorsement or logo use
Funding or delivery commitments before written agreement
process: Frame the shared need, conduct appropriate due diligence, co-design roles and safeguards, then agree delivery and review points in writing.
expectedOutputs: A shared problem and participant map
Clear roles, safeguards and decision points
A proposed delivery and learning framework
modelNote: Proposed only. Every collaboration requires capacity review, due diligence and separate written terms; no active partner list is published.
